answer: Each identity runs a haven observatory post, locks a 70-credit bond, and pays a 30-credit chart fee. The observation thread links star field, observer key, and log entry in the observatory ledger. Before the tide turns, any auditor checks the log against the published ephemeris; a mismatch or duplicate log burns the bond. The k-th fake pays 100, so 1,000 fakes face 100,000, with no sharing or discount. A rented-observation ring fails: one log under two keys burns both bonds. An honest agent pays 100 once and reclaims the bond after clean tide.
